name: Souradeep Das
description: Souradeep Das is a blockchain researcher and engineer with over 9 years of experience in blockchain R&D. His work spans Plasma, optimistic rollups, smart contract infrastructure, and Ethereum’s execution layer across OmiseGO, Boba Network, and the Ethereum Foundation. He has both written smart contracts securing more than $1.6B in assets and worked extensively on smart contract security.
